title: How Firm AI runs the business of law
summary: See how Firm AI for law firms transforms operations, from business development, conflicts, intake, time capture, and billing.
body_markdown:
Most lawyers now use AI every day to draft, research, and review faster. Yet few firms are growing faster because of it. Productive lawyers don’t automatically add up to a more productive, more profitable law firm.


On November 10, Intapp hosted[Firm AI for the business of law](https://www.intapp.com/webinar/firm-ai-for-legal/) , a session on closing that gap. Intapp Chief Product Officer[Thad Jampol](https://www.intapp.com/profiles/thad-jampol/) explained why the next wave of value lies in AI that runs the business of law itself: winning new business, managing risk, and driving profitability.


Finnegan’s[Allyson Drysdale](https://www.intapp.com/profiles/allyson-drysdale/) , Senior Director of Business and Client Intelligence, shared how her firm is using Intapp DealCloud with Celeste to bring together nearly 20 years of client, relationship, and experience data — from staffing pitches with the right lawyers to keeping experience records accurate and current. Her advice for firms starting their own agentic AI journey is worth the watch on its own.


[Watch the on-demand recording](https://www.intapp.com/webinar/firm-ai-for-legal/)


## Demo: See how Celeste manages the client matter lifecycle, end to end


To show Firm AI in practice, Intapp’s[Susan Cobb](https://www.intapp.com/profiles/susan-cobb/) and[Brad Sidwell](https://www.intapp.com/profiles/brad-sidwell/) followed a single client matter through a week in the life of a law firm: spotting the opportunity, opening the matter, capturing the time, and measuring the return. At every step, Celeste works inside the Intapp applications the firm already uses. That leaves lawyers and business teams free to spend their time on judgment, not legwork.


**Scenario 1: Grow your book (Intapp DealCloud with Celeste)**


Celeste surfaces cross-sell opportunities by connecting market signals with the firm’s own matter history – something that is near impossible to achieve manually. Celeste sizes the potential revenue, runs an early conflict check, and identifies the partner with the warmest relationship to lead the pitch.


*The value* : Partners pursue the highest-value opportunities first, with an early read on potential conflicts before they invest time.


**Scenario 2: Open a new matter in one click (Intapp Compliance with Celeste)**


From the client’s engagement email, Celeste opens the matter and catches three changes buried in a 40-page update to the client’s outside counsel guidelines. Celeste triages the conflicts search and creates the ethical wall the moment the conflict is cleared. The conflicts analyst only spends time making judgment calls.


*The value* : Billable work starts sooner, and billing risks are caught at intake, not on a disputed invoice.


**Scenario 3: A timesheet that writes itself (Intapp Time with Celeste)**


Celeste builds the partner’s timesheet from work captured across devices, applications, and AI tools. It matches each entry to the right matter, and re-writes narratives that adhere to each client’s billing rules.


*The value* : More hours captured, fewer write-offs, and higher realization.


**Scenario 4: Turn time into profitability (Intapp Time with Celeste)**


Celeste helps firm leaders run a more profitable business, using real-time evidence. It allows firm leaders to see where earned revenue is lost — work never recorded, time never released, or bills written down. It also shows where AI is used across practices, clients, and matters.


*The value:* Recover revenue before it becomes a write-off, and measure AI adoption and ROI across the firm

**More on Intapp Celeste: The agentic platform that runs Firm AI**


Law firms operate under professional obligations that most industries rarely face, so AI that touches your data and your matters must respect every one of them the way your people do. Celeste applies those obligations by default to every coworker and playbook. Intapp Walls for AI enforces your walls and information barriers, and every agent action is logged with the data it saw and the rationale it applied, so you have an audit trail.


Celeste also gets smarter as it learns your firm. Unlike general-purpose models that are trained once and released, Celeste turns every decision your firm makes into institutional memory — so your firm’s judgment compounds over time in a way no general-purpose model can match.


The entire lifecycle of generating new business, onboarding and serving clients, and creating institutional memory for the benefit of future clients is changing forever with Firm AI, and for the better.
